description: Searches the US Export Administration Regulations (15 CFR) text on eCFR for a term such as EAR99 or an ECCN, returning matching sections with a short excerpt, the part and the section. It shows regulatory text hits only; it does not decide the ECCN or licence requirement for a product. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

q.description: Search term, 3 to 80 characters, e.g. EAR99 or 5A992
